demoted._modifier: TypeScript partitions it: `override` is the one modifier a variable declaration may not carry (`'override' modifier cannot appear on a variable declaration`), while tsc's parser takes the rest. One alternation across all seven is exactly what accepted `override var x`. All seven members are concrete types occurring nowhere else, so facet membership selects the same nodes.
